Game Overview

In Noob Santa Christmas, the core idea is straightforward: guide Noob Santa through enchanting winter wonderlands, gathering scattered Santa hats to unlock and open treasure chests brimming with gifts. Master the art of double jumping and strategic planning to overcome obstacles and deliver joy to expectant children in this festive, heartwarming adventure.
